text: {"567":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"`rustc_ast::tokenstream` defines the compiler's unstable TokenStream."},"568":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"`rustc_expand` implements conversion between internal and stable proc-macro token streams, while rustc_ast supplies the internal type."},"569":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The proc-macro token-stream conversion implemented by rustc_expand uses the C ABI."},"570":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand implements proc macros, including custom derive macros."},"571":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The MBE declarative-macro system and its hygiene and scoping work are implemented in rustc_expand."}}
